title: Tanker hits and capsizes a riverboat in New Orleans, injuring 32
summary: Everyone on board was accounted for. Officials have called it a miracle that nobody died.
body:
A tanker struck a docked riverboat on the Mississippi River in New Orleans on Friday 13 November, causing it to capsize. Thirty-two people were taken to hospital, none with life-threatening injuries, and everyone on board was accounted for.

Mayor Helena Moreno said the asphalt tanker Atlantic Asphalt "lost control" and hit the paddlewheel cruise boat American Heritage at the Port of New Orleans' Thalia Street terminal.

Rescue and aftermath

Passengers were pulled from the river by other boats and emergency crews. The mayor said removing the riverboat could take weeks.

The Port of New Orleans has sued the tanker's owner and manager for about $1 million in repair costs.

Sources: CNN, ABC News, CBS News.
author: ICONDAILY
